procedure.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d) && for n in a b; do HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm bin/swissknifeman release bundle --root . --tag v0.0.0-p12 --out $H/$n || exit 1; done && (cd $H/a && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS) && test -f $H/a/compat.json && cmp $H/a/schemas-v0.0.0-p12.tar.gz $H/b/schemas-v0.0.0-p12.tar.gz && cmp $H/a/compat.json $H/b/compat.json
